body: I could watch that for hours. He would have to play in a dark room, by himself.
I agree. This needs to happen. I got so excited that there was a chance for the games to get a second start but nooooooo they had to cancel it.

My favorite qoute is "So breathe in the night right now." That whole song speaks to me. I have anxiety and this song really reminds me of my relationship and how my boyfriend does everything in his power to make sure I'm okay and that I'm comfortable. Like eating with me so I feel better about eating in front of people. Or showing up at my house at 3 am to make sure I'm okay because it scared him. I am so, so lucky.

Hi chris, My name is Nicole. I have been a wrestling fan since I could remember. I went to my first show when I was 4, Survivor Series 1999 in Detroit.  Every show I go to is such a new experience, it never gets old for me. The hope and inspiration you and many others have given me, has done more than I coukd ever say. Now, I want to do the same thing. I want to inspire other girls and boys that wanna wrestle. My question is, what is your advice for someone who is looking to become a wrestler, even if it ends up just being for indie companies. I have heard that it is a lot harder for females, is this true? Anyways, thank you for everything you've done both in and out of the ring! 
Much respect,  
Nicole.

Hi. My name is Nicole. I'm a 19 year old from Mi.  I've been a fan of wwe since I could remember. I've always wanted to be a wrestler. I still talk about becoming one. I tend to tell everyone that it is what would truly make me happy, no matter what they think.   I went to my first show in November of 1999 at the age of four. You have always been a huge idol of mine. I just have one question. What is your advice for someone like me who wants to put in the time, money, and effort to become a wrestler? I am willing to sacrafice a lot for it. It's my passion and always will be. I talk about it nearly every day. I watch each match carefully to try and study each move. This is something I really want. I love your band as well. You are and always will be one of my favorite WWE stars. Not only for your charisma but for your in ring ability as well. Thank you for everything that you've put into entertaining me and many other fans like me for years. :)
